## load libraries
```{r}
# install all dependencies
if (FALSE){
  if (!require("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE))
    install.packages("BiocManager")
  BiocManager::install("DESeq2") # compiled from source 
  BiocManager::install("edgeR")
  # install tidyverse (ggplot2 is in tidyverse)
  install.packages("tidyverse") 
  install.packages("gtable") 
}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(edgeR)
library(limma)
library(DESeq2)
```

## prepare data
```{r}
in_filename <- "/Users/miltr339/work/PhD_code/PhD_chapter4/data/gene_counts_standard.txt"
out_norm_counts <- "/Users/miltr339/work/PhD_code/PhD_chapter4/data/gene_counts_normalized.tsv"
metadata <- "/Users/miltr339/work/PhD_code/PhD_chapter4/data/larvae_metadata.csv"

## load data
  count_data <- read.csv(in_filename, header = TRUE, sep = "\t",comment.char = "#", check.names = FALSE)
  count_data <- count_data %>% select(-one_of('Chr','Start','End','Strand','Length')) 
  # make the Geneid the row id 
  count_data <- count_data %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames(var="Geneid")
  ## meta data
  DE_metadata_all <- read.csv(metadata, header = TRUE, sep = ",",comment.char = "#")
  # only include metadata when the samples are in the counts
  meta_data <- DE_metadata_all[which((DE_metadata_all$ID %in% names(count_data))==TRUE), ]
  meta_data <- meta_data %>% remove_rownames %>% column_to_rownames(var="ID")
  # reorder so it's in the same order as the count data columns
  meta_data <- meta_data[names(count_data),]
  # check assumptions, should be TRUE
  all(colnames(count_data) %in% rownames(meta_data))
  
## normalize library sizes
  # make sample groups that reflect line and day
  groups <- factor(paste(meta_data$line, meta_data$sex, meta_data$day, sep="_"))
  # read data into data structure
  y <- DGEList(counts=count_data, group=groups)
  #dim(y)
  #[1] 15702    82
  
  ## filter out low count genes
  # minimum count of 5 in at least some samples, and a minimum total count of 15 across all samples 
  keep <- filterByExpr(y, group=meta_data$line, min.count=5, min.total.count=15)
  y <- y[keep, , keep.lib.sizes=FALSE]
  y$samples$lib.size <- colSums(y$counts) # recompute library sizes
  # dim(y)
  # [1] 11641    82
  
  ## normalize by library sizes
  y <- calcNormFactors(y)
  
## export normalized counts to file
  log_norm_counts <- cpm(y,normalized.lib.sizes = TRUE,log = TRUE,prior.count = 1)
  write.table(log_norm_counts,file = out_norm_counts, sep = "\t",quote = FALSE)# ,col.names = NA)
  #### !!! manually add first header "geneID" to the file !!! ###
  
```
